fever.criteria: High body temperature above 101F or fever lasting more than 3 days.

chest_pain.criteria: Pressure, tightness, or pain in chest radiating to arm, jaw, or back.

breathing_difficulty.criteria: Shortness of breath, wheezing, or inability to speak in full sentences.

injury.criteria: Physical trauma, suspected fractures, deep lacerations, or head injury.

abdominal_pain.criteria: Severe stomach cramping, localized sharp abdominal pain, or persistent vomiting.
